name: Monotonic Minimum Teaching Set Size of Singletons
proof: Every nonempty subfamily of the singleton class with one concept has minimum teaching size zero. Every subfamily with at least two concepts has minimum teaching size one: a positive example identifies each target, and the empty sample identifies none. Thus the maximum over nonempty subfamilies is zero for $n=1$ and one for $n\ge2$. The general recursive-teaching identity makes this a corollary of the same singleton teaching computation.
